description:
About the role


Ergo are seeking an experienced and certified Azure Engineer (Level 3) with intermediate DevOps skills for permanent positions working out of our Dublin office (flexible remote work is fully supported when applicable). The successful Azure Engineer will support Ergo’s existing Azure Professional

Services team working with clients within hybrid on-prem and Azure architectures.

You will work at the leading edge of Azure projects in Ireland and forge your cloud career at one of only

a few Microsoft Azure Expert MSP partners around the world.

In addition to an exciting technology stack and great environment, we offer training incentives and

bonuses that reward self-starters who want to develop their skills and careers. Full mentorship and

guidance will be provided to the successful candidate.

Key role responsibilities

• Overall administration and management of customer Azure environments.

• Support Azure Architecture (IaaS & PaaS).

• Azure Governance configuration and remediation.

• Good understanding of DevOps technologies (GIT, Azure DevOps, YAML).

• Working knowledge of Bicep, Terraform or JSON.

• Strong Scripting skills (PowerShell and/or Azure CLI).

• Azure tenant and subscription administration.

• Azure Monitoring administration.

• Azure Backup and Disaster Recovery configuration and management.

• Demonstrate optimisation techniques and strategy within enterprise level organisations.

• Azure migration support from on-premises/other cloud to Azure.

• Automation of Azure infrastructure.

• Azure Security configuration and remediation.

• Microsoft Entra ID administration, including user and group management, role-based access control (RBAC), and identity governance.

Education, qualifications and skills

• 3+ years of experience in a similar role – Cloud Engineer, IT Administrator, Systems Engineer.

• Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to effectively articulate

technical challenges and solutions to our customers.

• Azure Core exam certification level required (AZ-104& AZ-305minimum).

Although not essential, the following skills would be beneficial:

• Microsoft System Center.

• Microsoft SQL Server.

• Containerisation technology (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes etc.).

• Full driving license will be an advantage.
